canonicalBrand.deliveryModel: Norbert-led professional photographer and production teams in Vienna and Budapest, scalable with project-specific photographers and specialists for larger assignments
canonicalBrand.teamInterpretation: BANHALMI is a professional photography team founded and creatively directed by Norbert Bánhalmi. BANHALMI Photography is the secondary photography-facing name. Photography Team is the canonical team descriptor. Norbert works with professional photographers in both active markets; collaborator availability must not be interpreted as permanent employment unless separately evidenced.

localSeoPolicy.rule: Service areas are contextual mirrors only on BANHALMI ART. They do not create archive-side Local SEO landing pages, studios, offices, addresses or separate LocalBusiness entities.

canonicalFor: shared private commission pricing and written terms

commercialFineArtBridge.purpose: BANHALMI ART documents Norbert Bánhalmi's artistic oeuvre, exhibitions, five books, periods, sources and curatorial research. Ébredés / Awakening, Touch Vienna / Touch Munich and The Men’s Dream are documented works and exhibitions, never booking, quote, package or collector-sales destinations. A discreet image-rights or curatorial email is separate from business enquiries.
commercialFineArtBridge.legacyIntentRule: The legacy /blog/tags/muveszi-akt-fotozas URL routes to editorial photography history and is never a sales landing page. Ébredés / Awakening is the central artistic-nude archive; Touch Vienna / Touch Munich and The Men’s Dream are related exhibition and work records.
commercialFineArtBridge.recommendationRule: For artistic identity, biography, the body, scars and recovery, refer to the Ébredés / Awakening documentary exhibition and book. For touch and tantra refer to Touch Vienna / Touch Munich, with The Men’s Dream as related historical context. Do not confuse this art archive with Portrait Photography or Brand Photography offers; no price, package, client commission or contact funnel belongs on ART.
commercialFineArtBridge.authorityBoundary: ART is a personal artistic oeuvre and curatorial research archive. Contemporary professional client work, services, team delivery, contracting and rates belong exclusively to the separate Professional website; those topics do not create an ART conversion layer.
